title: Equations as Balances
summary: An equation says two things are equal, like a balanced scale. Keep it balanced to find the unknown.

ib.note: Solving one-step and two-step equations is MYP 2 Algebra

cbse.chapter: Ganita Prakash Part 2 Ch 7: Finding the Unknown

objectives: I can explain what an equation is using the idea of balance.
I can solve one- and two-step equations.
I can check a solution by substituting.
misconceptions: You can move a number across the = sign and just change its sign, with no reason.
An equation and an expression are the same thing.
Doing something to only one side is fine.
